litigation.mdlName: In re: Abbott Laboratories, et al., Preterm Infant Nutrition Products Liability Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, Northern District of Illinois

phase: Active MDL; bellwether rulings, appeals, and individual pretrial proceedings
phaseDetail: JPML lists MDL-3026 as active before Judge Rebecca R. Pallmeyer. In July 2026 the Seventh Circuit affirmed an Abbott bellwether summary judgment on case-specific warning causation and separately reversed a jurisdiction ruling in five Mead cases without deciding their product-liability merits.

settlements.label: No global MDL settlement program identified in reviewed official records
settlements.detail: The official JPML and federal appellate records reviewed September 22, 2026 do not announce a global MDL settlement program, compensation matrix, or universal payment deadline. A verdict, dismissal, remand, or settlement in one case does not set another case's value.
settlements.individualClaims: No universal NEC formula payout amount is verified here.
settlements.source: JPML September 2026 report and Seventh Circuit MDL opinions

keyDates.label: MDL-3026 established
keyDates.detail: JPML centralized federal preterm infant nutrition product cases in the Northern District of Illinois before Judge Rebecca R. Pallmeyer.

keyDates.label: Seventh Circuit affirmed Abbott bellwether summary judgment
keyDates.detail: In Mar v. Abbott Laboratories, the court affirmed summary judgment because the plaintiff had not shown that the proposed warning would have prevented the infant's death; it did not decide the broader formula-causation issue Abbott asked it to reach.
keyDates.source: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit

keyDates.label: Seventh Circuit reversed jurisdiction ruling in five Mead cases
keyDates.detail: The court rejected the district court's fraudulent-joinder analysis and remanded for further proceedings; the opinion did not decide defect or causation on the merits.
keyDates.source: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit

keyDates.label: 847 actions pending
keyDates.detail: JPML reports 847 pending actions and 1,057 historical actions in MDL-3026.

updates.summary: JPML reports 847 pending actions and 1,057 historical actions, compared with 825 pending and 1,035 historical actions on August 3.
The Seventh Circuit reversed a federal-jurisdiction ruling in five Mead cases and remanded without deciding their product-liability merits.
The Seventh Circuit affirmed summary judgment for Abbott in the Mar bellwether on case-specific warning causation while declining to decide a broader product-causation issue.
